text: I feel an air of curiosity and quiet anticipation in this place. The rooms and displays blend the sterility of a meeting space with the creative energy of an exhibition area, inviting questions about innovation and collaboration. I am both observer and participant, reflecting on the ways in which knowledge is created and shared among us. Here, I am surrounded by the promise of ideas in motion, making me eager to engage, but also contemplative about the purposes and processes that give rise to such environments.
